verdict: Strong foundation but needs sharper outcome focus and demo-driven proof

dimensions.finding: Clear value proposition but could be more specific about target audience
dimensions.evidence: Financial infrastructure to grow your revenue. Accept payments, offer financial services, and implement custom revenue models
dimensions.fix: Add 'for businesses of all sizes' to headline to immediately define audience

dimensions.finding: Focuses on features over customer outcomes
dimensions.evidence: Accept payments, offer financial services, and implement custom revenue models
dimensions.fix: Reframe features as outcomes: 'Increase global sales by accepting 135+ payment methods'

dimensions.finding: Strong social proof with logos and metrics, but lacks visual demonstration
dimensions.evidence: 50% of Fortune 100 companies have used Stripe; $1.9T in payments volume processed
dimensions.fix: Add short demo videos showing Stripe in action for different business types

dimensions.finding: Heavy on text, light on product demonstration
dimensions.evidence: Page relies primarily on text descriptions and statistics
dimensions.fix: Incorporate product screenshots and workflow animations to show how Stripe works

dimensions.finding: Uses some concrete numbers but could be more specific about benefits
dimensions.evidence: 135+ currencies and payment methods supported; 99.999% historical uptime
dimensions.fix: Quantify benefits: 'Reduce payment processing time by 50%' instead of 'optimize payments'

dimensions.finding: Clear primary CTA but secondary options create distraction
dimensions.evidence: Start now; Contact sales; Get started; Sign up with Google
dimensions.fix: Consolidate to one primary CTA: 'Start growing your revenue with Stripe'

priority_fixes.fix: Add product demo videos showing Stripe in action for different business scenarios
Reframe feature descriptions as specific customer outcomes with quantifiable benefits
Streamline CTAs to focus on single primary action: starting with Stripe

headline_fix: Grow your business globally with Stripe's all-in-one financial infrastructure
